title: Compositional differential oracle for Hot-Envelope

immutability.rule: This manifest must not be edited after the first Hot-Envelope capture (protocol phase 0 step 6). Corrections are appended to amendments with a timestamp and reason.

ciKnownAcceptedFailure.reason: Lighting.hlsl:953 includes WetnessEffects/WetnessEffects.hlsli under an elif on WETNESS_EFFECTS; that job sets the define without putting the feature shader directory on the include path. Wetness Effects is in AIO_NON_SHIPPED_FEATURE_PACKAGES. Pre-existing upstream, unrelated to this work.
ciKnownAcceptedFailure.acceptedOnlyIf: byte-for-byte the same failure; any new failure blocks the phase

stateAtBaseline: VRGeometryPolicy::Derive is authoritative for render-scale allocation and render extent
engineRenderSize and engineAllocationSize are mutually non-convertible types (phase 1a, behaviour-null)
the planner is NOT authoritative for the RS-off render extent - see parked item P-1
finalOutputSize is still assigned directly rather than derived

governorPlugin.note: The commit this experiment started from. The phase 0 freeze itself is 388ff28 and 6bf63d1, which contain this manifest.

dllUnderTest.note: Hashed after installation from the exact CI artifact. No locally compiled DLL is admissible as evidence (protocol section 15).

acceptedCandidateTransforms.note: Compiled and golden-valued in phase 1, before any runtime data is seen.

edgeContracts.note: Immutable once added (protocol section 8.4). Every scored edge needs a normative source, formula, units, sample rules, exact checks, tolerances, and PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE conditions.

testMatrix.localizationNote: ON-Q3 and ON-Q4 are separate boots or separately verified relatches, never two transient dwells in one unsettled session.
testMatrix.severityNote: Run only after the first-divergence frontier is identified at Balanced. Performance and UltraPerformance retain their documented vendor-range caveat and confirm a trend only; no result from them explains Balanced (discipline rule 13).
testMatrix.startsAtBalanced: Balanced is the smallest non-zero envelope divergence and stays inside the measured DLSS ranged-mode contract, so the known Performance and UltraPerformance vendor-range violations cannot be used to explain a defect that exists earlier.

expectedGeometry.unitsNote: Combined stereo, for compactness. Runtime and analyzer records must carry the CombinedStereo / PerEye(i) / ArraySlice(i,s) tag; a combined number is a logical two-eye extent, not a claim about physical layout.
expectedGeometry.arithmeticNote: The 2-pixel width difference between OFF-Q4 (4110) and HE-Q3-Q4 (4108) is known arithmetic, not the defect: RS-off scales combined width and truncates; RS-on and Hot-Envelope scale per eye and force even. Comparisons use each flow authoritative integer extent and compare normalized logical coordinates. The two paths are never forced to one value.

hypothesisH1.statement: Skyrim already expands the complete R image to A, after which the submit-stage path crops an R-sized portion and asks the vendor to expand it to O.
hypothesisH1.anisotropyNote: The prediction is per axis and is NOT isotropic at Balanced or Performance (1.1334 vs 1.1338; 1.3333 vs 1.3341), because the even-forcing in ScaleVRRenderDimension bites the two axes differently. That asymmetry is itself a discriminator: an observed zoom that is isotropic where the prediction is anisotropic is evidence against a pure A/R duplicate expansion. Both axes are therefore scored, never just the horizontal.
hypothesisH1.falsifier: The complete boundary ledger shows no preceding R to A expansion AND the capture immediately before the submit-stage source copy shows the complete logical eye field occupying exactly R_eye pixels. Seeing an R_eye field at a single boundary is not sufficient - it could have been expanded and resampled back earlier.
hypothesisH1.decidedBy: the fitted coordinate transform, never a visual statement

settlePeriod.rule: Fixed before capture. Must not be shortened because a result looks stable.

frameAdmission: no relatch pending or in progress
A, R, O unchanged for at least 120 frames
history reset clear for at least 120 frames
both eyes present in one compositor cycle
one plan hash and one contract generation across all joined records
provider reset completed through the fixed warm-up sequence

calibrationRule.principle: Thresholds are calibrated only from each instrument own working-flow controls and frozen before Hot-Envelope is scored. Passive and world-to-B2 thresholds freeze in phase 5; BF marker thresholds are calibrated independently and freeze in phase 7.
steps: at least four independently admitted compositor cycles per control, over at least two game launches
assign complete cycles - not points from one image - to calibration and holdout before analysis
candidate error is the maximum reprojection displacement over every decoded corner, center, quarter point and image corner
image tolerance = max(2 pixels, 2 x calibration-control P99 reprojection error)
at least 12 decoded markers, all four quadrants represented, analyzer synthetic-fixture confidence gate passing
all held-out controls must pass unchanged
exact metadata, integer seam and containment checks stay at zero tolerance
calibrationRule.tieRule: If two candidate transforms both fall inside tolerance the result is INCONCLUSIVE, not whichever is closer.

runRejectionRules: build commit or DLL hash absent or wrong
settings not read from disk and archived in the same session
governor or another owner changed quality
a menu or loading context overlaps the scored frame
requested quality does not equal readback
a relatch, vendor reset, fallback, device loss or transition protection is active
either eye missing, or the eyes have different compositor-cycle policy
joined boundaries use different plan hashes, contract generations or history generations
any source capture occurs before its producer completed
passive telemetry changed the control path
resource capture or fiducial instrumentation changed the control path, resource contract, provider state or history sequence
analyzer confidence below its frozen threshold
a manual observation is needed to decide between candidate transforms
rejectionHandling: An invalid run is archived and labelled REJECTED with its reason. It is never silently deleted, and never reused for a weaker claim.
nonSuccessRule: All boundaries valid while the endpoint is objectively invalid means at least one theorem assumption is false. That is reported as one of the above, never as geometry is correct.
scopeLimit: Without an external compositor boundary B8, this protocol proves the path only through the OpenVR texture and bounds submitted at B7. A headset symptom beyond B7 stays inside the compositor and runtime opaque block.
